fields.default: What new students ask about our evening Spanish courses, in the format we trust most.

itemFields.name: question
itemFields.label: Question
itemFields.default: Can I join in the middle of a term?

itemFields.name: answer
itemFields.label: Answer
itemFields.default: Yes, up to week four. We charge only for the lessons that are left.

default.question: Which level should I join?
default.answer: Book the free 15-minute placement chat with a teacher. You leave with a level from A1 to C1 and a class to match.

default.question: How big are the classes?
default.answer: Six to nine students, never more than ten. Small enough that everyone speaks in every lesson.

default.question: What if I fall behind?
default.answer: Every course includes two 30-minute catch-up sessions with your teacher. Use them whenever the subjunctive wins.

default.question: Do you teach online as well?
default.answer: Yes. Each evening group has a live online twin on the same timetable, so you can switch week by week when you travel.

default.question: How much is a term?
default.answer: A 10-week term is £245 with the coursebook included. You can pay in two halves at no extra cost.

default.question: Will I get a certificate?
default.answer: You get a CEFR level certificate at the end of each term. From B1 upwards we also run DELE exam preparation.
